import PV_L2C_HashRange
import PV_L2C_GeneratedRange
import PV_L2C_DigestRange
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_DigestOrigin
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R1Z R0Z.WriterRefine BuilderForestAdmissionPort
local instance : ExternalLinear := PV_Src_ExternalReference.dictionary

/-- Sources of raw digest words on the reviewed routes. This carrier stores
decoder/generator/hash executions, rather than the N3 guard's conclusion. -/
inductive Origin (d : Array U32 8#usize) : Prop where
  | decoded (bytes : Array U8 32#usize)
      (returned : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical bytes = ok (.Ok d))
  | generated (prior : Fin 8 → U32)
      (returned : ∀ j : Fin 8, d.val[j.val]! = PV_L2C_GeneratedRange.remainder (prior j))
  | hashed (domain : U32) (input : Slice U32)
      (domainBound : domain.val < 2147483647)
      (lengthBound : input.val.length < 2147483647) (nonempty : input.val ≠ [])
      (returned : poseidon2.hash_fields domain input = ok d)

theorem canonical (d : Array U32 8#usize) (h : Origin d) : Canon8 d := by
  cases h with
  | decoded bytes returned =>
    intro j hj
    apply PV_L2C_DigestRange.digest_success bytes d returned
    have hb : j < d.val.length := by simpa only [d.property,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hj
    rw [getElem!_pos d.val j hb]
    exact List.getElem_mem hb
  | generated prior returned =>
    intro j hj
    rw [returned ⟨j,hj⟩]
    exact PV_L2C_GeneratedRange.remainder_range _
  | hashed domain input hd hl hn hr =>
    exact PV_L2C_HashRange.success domain input d hd hl hn hr
#print axioms canonical

theorem excludes_P (d : Array U32 8#usize) (h : Origin d) :
    ∀ j : Fin 8, d.val[j.val]! ≠ 2147483647#u32 := by
  intro j he
  have hb := canonical d h j.val j.isLt
  rw [he] at hb
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl 2147483647 hb
#print axioms excludes_P
end PV_L2C_DigestOrigin

import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_PairChecks29
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_PairRange
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R1Z R1Z.BuilderForestAdmissionPort

/-- The source validates both raw occupancy coordinates before using their
field equations. This includes the inverse, not only commitment digests. -/
theorem coordinates (p : pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLeafWitnessV1)
    (h : p.validate = ok (.Ok ())) :
    p.second_occupied.val < 2147483647 ∧
    p.second_occupancy_inverse.val < 2147483647 := by
  unfold pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLeafWitnessV1.validate at h
  pv_peel h with first hf
  cases first <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte] at h
  · cases h
  · pv_peel h with second hs
    cases second <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte] at h
    · cases h
    · split at h
      · cases h
      · rename_i ho
        split at h
        · cases h
        · rename_i hi
          have ho' : ¬ 2147483647 ≤ p.second_occupied.val := by
            simpa only [UScalar.le_equiv,aspis_core.field.P,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using ho
          have hi' : ¬ 2147483647 ≤ p.second_occupancy_inverse.val := by
            simpa only [UScalar.le_equiv,aspis_core.field.P,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hi
          exact ⟨by omega,by omega⟩
#print axioms coordinates
end PV_L2C_PairRange

import PV_L2C_DigestRange
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_DigestList
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
abbrev Bytes := Array U8 32#usize
abbrev Digest := Array U32 8#usize
abbrev Error := atomic_statement.AtomicStatementError

/-- Ordered field-decode reference cut: first error is retained, and every
successful field is returned at its original position. -/
def run : List Bytes → Result (core.result.Result (List Digest) Error)
  | [] => ok (.Ok [])
  | b::bs => do
    let d ← atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical b
    match d with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
    | .Ok d =>
      let rest ← run bs
      match rest with
      | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
      | .Ok ds => ok (.Ok (d::ds))

theorem success (bytes : List Bytes) (ds : List Digest)
    (h : run bytes = ok (.Ok ds)) :
    ds.length = bytes.length ∧ ∀ d ∈ ds, ∀ x ∈ d.val, x.val < 2147483647 := by
  induction bytes generalizing ds with
  | nil => cases h; exact ⟨rfl,by simp⟩
  | cons b bs ih =>
    rw [run] at h
    pv_peel h with first hf
    cases first with
    | Err e => cases h
    | Ok d =>
      pv_peel h with rest hr
      cases rest with
      | Err e => cases h
      | Ok tail =>
        cases h
        obtain ⟨hlen,hcan⟩ := ih tail hr
        refine ⟨by simpa using hlen,?_⟩
        intro v hv
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with he | ht
        · subst v; exact PV_L2C_DigestRange.digest_success b d hf
        · exact hcan v ht
#print axioms success

theorem field (bytes : List Bytes) (ds : List Digest) (h : run bytes = ok (.Ok ds))
    (j : Nat) (hj : j < bytes.length) :
    ∃ d, ds[j]? = some d ∧ ∀ x ∈ d.val, x.val < 2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨hl,hc⟩ := success bytes ds h
  have inside : j < ds.length := by omega
  exact ⟨ds[j],List.getElem?_eq_getElem inside,hc _ (List.getElem_mem inside)⟩
#print axioms field
end PV_L2C_DigestList
